The recession began in December 2007 and ended in June 2009. If he got his engineering degree in mid 2005 he could not have worked for five years before the end of the recession. /* U.S. House of Representatives */ I could not find a source directly linking Blue Dog losses to conservative momentum nationwide, however, there was a clear conservative "wave" within SC that should be noted.
